_comment: Menu blueprint for AF3. generate_menu.py turns this into AF3 skinvariables files: a home (Discover) widget file, per-slot widget files, a 1104 More Providers submenu with per-provider sub-pages, and a slot manifest. AF3 only renders rows on home + slots 1101-1104 (the 5-slot cap), so Apple TV+ / Disney+ / Prime Video are nested under the 1104 More Providers submenu. Each widget may carry an ordered params map that becomes its TMDb Helper query, or the leaner info/tmdb_type pair. Provider IDs are TMDb watch-provider IDs, region US. No secrets here; Trakt and debrid are authenticated on-device.

widgets.label: Continue Watching
widgets._comment: Trakt playback progress for episodes: started but not finished, most recently paused first. TMDb Helper's current trakt_ondeck maps tmdb_type binarily (episode for tv, movie otherwise), so 'both' silently collapsed to movies only; movies get their own row below.

widgets.label: Continue Movies
widgets._comment: Trakt playback progress for movies: started but not finished, most recently paused first.

widgets.label: My Calendar
widgets._comment: My shows' episodes aired in the past 2 weeks ending yesterday (startdate=-14, days=14: window today-14 to today-1). The calendar route auto-reverses when the start is in the past (newest first) but paginates BEFORE reversing, so with the default 20-item page the first page held the OLDEST week. length=3 raises the page size to 3 x 20 = 60 items so the whole window fits one page and yesterday's episodes come first. sort_by/sort_how are ignored by this route and were removed.

_provider_rows_comment: Rows for every More Providers sub-page (Apple TV+, Disney+, Prime Video). Latest + Trending series and latest movies for that provider.
_full_provider_rows_comment: Top-level provider slots (Netflix, Max). Latest and trending for both series and movies, plus top rated.
